sentences.Annette og Steinar bor i Akershus, fire: Annette and Steinar live in Akershus, forty kilometres from Lillestrøm.
sentences.De bor i en treroms leilighet på 82 kvad: They live in a three-room flat of 82 square metres.
sentences.Steinar jobber i Lillestrøm, og Annette: Steinar works in Lillestrøm, and Annette stays at home with two little girls aged four and two.
sentences.Nå har hun besøk av Line, ei venninne fr: Now she has a visit from Line, a friend from her school days.
sentences.Hvor lenge har dere bodd her?: How long have you lived here?
sentences.I fire år. Leiligheten er fin og utsikte: For four years. The flat is nice and the view is lovely, but we, or especially I, want to move.
I'd like to move to Lillestrøm.
sentences.Nå har jeg vært hjemme med ungene ganske: I've been at home with the kids for quite a long time now and want to find a job.
sentences.Det er lettere å få seg en jobb i Lilles: It's easier to get a job in Lillestrøm than here.
sentences.Her er det både boligblokker og rekkehus: There are both blocks of flats and terraced houses here, and there are big green areas.
Besides, everything is more expensive in Lillestrøm.
sentences.Det er synd at alt er så dyrt, men vi ka: It's a pity everything is so expensive, but we can take out a bigger loan.
sentences.Har dere sett etter ny bolig?: Have you been looking for a new home?
sentences.Ikke Steinar, men jeg leser boligannonse: Steinar hasn't, but I read the property ads in the local paper and keep an eye on finn.no.
sentences.I går så jeg en fin leilighet midt i Lil: Yesterday I saw a nice flat in the middle of Lillestrøm.
sentences.Leiligheten er litt mindre enn denne, me: The flat is a bit smaller than this one, but not that much more expensive than the one we have now.
sentences.Skal dere legge inn bud?: Are you going to put in a bid?
sentences.Jeg har lyst til å overta gården etter f: I'd like to take over the farm from my parents.
sentences.Da må vi i hvert fall ta opp mer lån!: Then we'll definitely have to take out a bigger loan!
sentences.Det er en gammel bondegård, og foreldren: It's an old farm, and Steinar's parents haven't done it up for many, many years.
sentences.Hva mener du, Annette? Har du lyst til å: What do you think, Annette? Do you want to move to the countryside and become a farmer's wife?
sentences.Jeg vet ikke. Jeg trives både i byen og: I don't know. I'm happy both in town and in the countryside.
You do like being on the farm.
Yes, I do, and I love animals. But I really love city life too. Oh, this is hard.
